::: {.callout-tip title="Video lecture"}
Hutchinson's [Probability Refresher](https://facultyweb.cs.wwu.edu/~hutchib2/video_lectures/data371/#probability_refresher) (27 min)
covers conditional distributions, the law of total probability,
the chain rule of probability, and Bayes' rule [@hutchinson_wwu_ml_videos].
The login for the video site is posted [on Canvas](https://wwu.instructure.com/courses/1906010/modules#module_3922392).
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Another explanation"}
The University of Washington's [CSE 312](https://courses.cs.washington.edu/courses/cse312/20su/) materials and videos
by Alex Tsun teach probability and statistics for computing,
and cover counting, conditional probability and Bayes' rule from a computer science viewpoint.
:::

::: {.videos}
5MinuteAI's five-minute videos follow the same course
[@fiveminuteai_probstat]:
[introduction to discrete probability](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LfdTIvLfdtA)
and [conditional probability](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c-yB3q7zYlU).
:::
